info.title: NexDesk API
info.description: Multi-tenant help desk and SLA management. Errors are RFC 7807 problem documents whose `code` field is a stable, machine-readable slug.

get.summary: Returns the API name and version.
Lists the customers of the workspace, optionally filtered by name or email.
Returns the oldest app builds the API still supports, and the web app's address.

Lists who created, changed or deleted what in the workspace, newest first, with each field's value before and after and the address the change came from. Search matches the record's name, or a record or actor id.

post.summary: Turns an email into a ticket, or into a reply when the subject contains a reference like [#42]. The mail gateway authenticates with the X-Inbound-Secret header.
Creates a workspace and its owner account, then emails a verification link.
Signs a staff user in and sets the refresh-token cookie.
Confirms an email address with the emailed token and signs the user in.
Sends a new verification link if the account exists and is not yet verified.
Sends a password-reset link if the account exists. Always answers 202.
Sets a new password with the emailed token and signs out every session.
Rotates the refresh token from the cookie and returns a new access token.
Revokes the current refresh-token family and clears the cookie.

get.summary: Returns the signed-in user, their workspace and their permissions.

post.summary: Signs a staff user in on the mobile app and returns both tokens.
Rotates the refresh token from the body and returns the new pair. Replaying an old one ends the session.
Revokes the refresh-token family the given token belongs to.

get.summary: Lists the staff of the workspace. Sort by name, email, createdAt or lastLoginAt; prefix with - to reverse.
Returns one staff member.

put.summary: Changes a staff member's role. Only owners can grant or remove the owner role.

post.summary: Deactivates a staff member and signs them out everywhere.
Lets a deactivated staff member sign in again.

put.summary: Updates the signed-in user's name and language.
Sets the signed-in agent's availability: Online, Away or Offline.

post.summary: Changes the password, signs out other devices and returns a fresh token pair.

get.summary: Lists invitations that are still pending or have expired.

post.summary: Invites a person by email to join the workspace with a role.
Sends the invitation again with a new link and a new expiry date.

delete.summary: Revokes a pending invitation so its link stops working.

get.summary: Shows which workspace and role an invitation link is for.

post.summary: Creates the invited account and signs it in.

get.summary: Lists teams with their members.

post.summary: Creates a team, optionally with its first members.

put.summary: Renames a team or changes its description.

delete.summary: Deletes a team. Its members keep their accounts.

put.summary: Replaces the member list of a team.

get.summary: Returns the workspace time zone and weekly opening hours.

put.summary: Sets the workspace time zone and the opening hours of each weekday.

get.summary: Returns how far the workspace setup has progressed.

post.summary: Marks the setup wizard as finished.

get.summary: Lists tickets. Repeat status or priority to match several values; search looks in subjects, messages, requesters and ticket numbers; sla keeps tickets that breached or are at risk. Sort by lastActivityAt, createdAt, number, priority or due; prefix with - to reverse.

post.summary: Creates a ticket on behalf of a customer. The requester is matched by email or created.

get.summary: Returns one ticket with its requester, assignee, team and watchers.

patch.summary: Changes the subject, status, priority, type or tags. Omitted fields stay as they are.

delete.summary: Deletes a ticket. It disappears from every list but its number is never reused.

put.summary: Sets the assignee and team of a ticket. Send null to clear either one.

post.summary: Adds a public reply or an internal note, optionally changing the status in the same step.

get.summary: Returns the conversation and every recorded change of a ticket, oldest first.

put.summary: Subscribes the signed-in user to updates of a ticket.

delete.summary: Unsubscribes the signed-in user from updates of a ticket.

post.summary: Changes status, priority, assignment or tags of up to 100 tickets and reports which ones failed.
Merges a duplicate into another ticket: its conversation moves there and it is closed.
Uploads one file of up to 10 MB. Pass the returned id when creating a ticket or message.

get.summary: Downloads an attachment.
Lists the ticket fields this workspace has defined, in display order.

post.summary: Defines a new ticket field. The key and type cannot be changed afterwards.

put.summary: Changes the label, options, position or whether the field is required or active.

delete.summary: Removes a field definition. Values already stored on tickets are no longer shown.

get.summary: Lists the signed-in user's own ticket views and the views shared with the workspace.

post.summary: Saves a ticket filter under a name. Sharing it with everyone needs an admin.

put.summary: Renames a view or replaces its filter.

get.summary: Returns the first-response and resolution targets of each priority, in working minutes.

put.summary: Sets the targets of one or more priorities. Open tickets pick them up on their next change.

get.summary: Lists the days the workspace is closed.

post.summary: Adds a day on which SLA clocks do not run.

get.summary: Lists missed deadlines, newest first.
Lists the signed-in user's notifications, newest first.
Returns how many notifications the signed-in user has not read yet.

post.summary: Marks one notification as read and returns the remaining unread count.
Marks every notification of the signed-in user as read.

get.summary: Returns, per notification type, whether the user wants it in the app, by email and as a phone push.

put.summary: Switches notification types on or off in the app, by email and as a phone push. Leaving push out keeps its stored value.
Registers this install of the mobile app for push notifications, or refreshes its push token.

delete.summary: Stops push notifications to this install. Removing one that is not registered is fine.

get.summary: Lists the article categories with the number of articles in each, drafts included.

post.summary: Adds a category.

put.summary: Renames, describes or reorders a category.

delete.summary: Removes a category that has no articles left.

get.summary: Lists articles by title, optionally narrowed by category, status or a search term.

post.summary: Writes an article. It stays a draft unless `publish` is true.

get.summary: Returns an article with its Markdown source and the HTML it renders to.

put.summary: Edits an article. Its address in the help centre does not change.

post.summary: Makes an article visible in the help centre.
Turns an article back into a draft, hiding it from the help centre.
Renders Markdown exactly as the help centre will show it.

get.summary: Lists the workspace's automation rules in the order they run.

post.summary: Adds a rule: a trigger, conditions joined by all/any, and the actions to carry out.

get.summary: Returns one rule with its conditions and actions.

put.summary: Replaces a rule's trigger, conditions and actions.

delete.summary: Deletes a rule and its execution log.

post.summary: Turns a rule on.
Turns a rule off without deleting it or its log.

get.summary: Lists when the rule ran, on which ticket and what became of each action, newest first.
Lists the plans with their prices and limits. A limit of null means unlimited.
Returns the workspace's plan and the period it is paid for.
Returns how much of each plan allowance the workspace has used.

post.summary: Moves the workspace to another plan. Paid plans take a simulated card payment and produce a paid invoice; card 4000 0000 0000 0002 is always declined.

get.summary: Lists the workspace's invoices, newest first.
Downloads an invoice as a PDF.
Returns the headline figures of a period: volume, backlog, response times, SLA compliance and CSAT.
Returns tickets created and solved per day, or per week for periods longer than two months.
Returns the tickets that still need work, by status and by priority, as they stand now.
Returns the average first-response and resolution time, in minutes, per day or week.
Returns how many tickets met or missed each SLA target, overall and by priority.
Returns the satisfaction score, the spread of ratings and how the score moved.
Returns each agent's solved tickets, response times and satisfaction score, most solved first.
Downloads a report as CSV. Names: volume, backlog, response-times, sla-compliance, csat, agents, tickets.
Lists the workspace's API keys, active ones first. The keys themselves are never shown again.

post.summary: Issues a key for the public API. The response holds the full key, which is shown only this once; send it in the X-Api-Key header. Requires a plan with API access.

delete.summary: Revokes a key. Requests made with it are refused from now on; it stays listed for the record.

get.summary: Lists the endpoints that receive the workspace's events.

post.summary: Adds an endpoint. The response holds its signing secret, shown only this once. Each request carries X-NexDesk-Signature: t={unix seconds},v1={hex HMAC-SHA256 of "{t}.{body}" with the secret}. Failed deliveries are retried up to 6 times over about 9 hours. Requires a plan with API access.

put.summary: Changes an endpoint's address, events or description, or switches it off.

delete.summary: Removes an endpoint and its delivery log.

post.summary: Replaces the signing secret. The new one is returned this once; the old one stops being used at once.
Sends a signed ping event, to check that the endpoint answers and verifies signatures.

get.summary: Lists what was sent to an endpoint, newest first, with the response to the latest attempt.

post.summary: Sends a delivery's payload again as a new delivery, keeping the original's record.

get.summary: Returns the workspace's name, time zone, default language and help centre branding.

put.summary: Changes the workspace's name, time zone, default language, accent colour and welcome text.

post.summary: Replaces the logo with a PNG, JPEG or WebP image of up to 512 KB, sent as the form field "file". The type is read from the file's content, not its name.

delete.summary: Removes the logo; the help centre shows the workspace name instead.

get.summary: Lists every workspace with its plan, team size and this month's tickets. Search matches the name, address or owner email.
Returns a read-only overview of a workspace: plan, usage against its limits, totals, admins and recent invoices. It never shows ticket or customer content.

post.summary: Closes a workspace: its team, customers, API keys and webhooks stop working at once. No data is deleted, and the workspace's audit log records the change as made by NexDesk.
Reopens a suspended workspace.

get.summary: Returns workspace counts, current monthly recurring revenue by plan, and per month for the last 1 to 36 months: revenue under contract at the month's end and new sign-ups.

post.summary: Returns a single-use address, valid for one minute, that opens the background job dashboard.

get.summary: Returns the public name, language and branding of a workspace's help centre: accent colour, welcome text and the logo's address.
Returns the workspace's logo image. Use the versioned address from the help centre info.

post.summary: Emails a link for choosing a password to the given address. Always answers 202; the password is only ever set by whoever opens that email.
Signs a customer in to the help centre.
Emails a link to choose a password if the address belongs to a customer. Always answers 202.
Sets a customer's password with the emailed token. This is also how a new account is activated.
Rotates the customer's refresh cookie and returns a new access token.
Ends the customer's session.

get.summary: Returns the signed-in customer.
Lists the signed-in customer's own requests.

post.summary: Submits a new request on behalf of the signed-in customer.

get.summary: Returns one of the customer's requests with its public conversation.

post.summary: Adds the customer's reply. A solved or pending request is reopened.
Rates a solved request from 1 to 5, with an optional comment.
Uploads a file the customer can attach to a request or reply.

get.summary: Downloads a file from the public conversation of the customer's own request.
Shows which request a satisfaction survey link is about.

post.summary: Rates a solved request through the emailed survey link, without signing in.

get.summary: Lists the categories that have at least one published article.
Lists or searches published articles. The last search word matches as a prefix.
Returns a published article as HTML and counts the view. Drafts are not found.

post.summary: Records whether a reader found the article helpful.

get.summary: Lists tickets, newest activity first. Needs the tickets:read scope.

post.summary: Opens a ticket for a customer, on the API channel. Needs the tickets:write scope.

get.summary: Returns one ticket. Needs the tickets:read scope.

patch.summary: Changes a ticket's subject, status, priority, type, tags or custom fields. Needs the tickets:write scope.

post.summary: Adds a reply or an internal note to a ticket. Needs the tickets:write scope.

ActorType.description: Who performed an action on a ticket.

examples.body: Thanks for the report. We fixed the download link, could you try again?

AdminTenantDetail.description: A read-only look at one workspace. Nothing in it lets the platform act as the workspace.

ApiKeyDto.description: An issued key. `Hint` is its start, enough to recognise it, such as `ndk_3f9a0c1b7e42_…`.

AssignTicketRequest.description: Both fields are applied as sent; null clears the assignee or the team.

AuditChange.description: One field of a record before and after a change, written as display text.

AuthResponse.description: The access token for API calls. The refresh token travels only in an HttpOnly cookie.

BacklogDto.description: Tickets that still need work, as they stand right now.

BulkUpdateRequest.description: Applies the same changes to many tickets. Assignee and team are only touched when their flag is set.

CheckoutRequest.description: The card fields belong to a simulated payment form: nothing is charged and the number is not stored.

examples.subject: Cannot download my invoice
examples.description: The download button on the billing page shows an error since this morning.

url.description: Where to post events: a full http or https address.

events.description: Any of ticket.created, ticket.updated, ticket.assigned, ticket.replied and ticket.solved.

description.description: A note on what receives the events.

CsatSurveyDto.description: What a customer sees before rating through an emailed survey link.

examples.comment: Solved, but it took a while.

ExecutionStep.description: What became of one action when a rule ran.

examples.subject: Re: Cannot download my invoice [#42]
examples.text: Here is the screenshot you asked for.

name.description: What the key is for, such as the integration that uses it.

expiresInDays.description: How long the key works, from 1 to 730 days. Leave empty for a key that does not expire.

IssuedApiKeyDto.description: A newly issued key. string IssuedApiKeyDto.Key is shown this once and cannot be read again.

MobileAuthResponse.description:
Both tokens, for the mobile app, which keeps the refresh token in the device's secure storage. It rotates on
every refresh: store the new one before using the new access token.

MobileConfigDto.description: What the app checks on start: whether it is too old, and where the web app is for web-only pages.

MonthlyPoint.description: A month's value: revenue under contract at its end, or workspaces created in it.

NotificationPreferenceInput.description: A change to one notification type. Leaving Push out keeps the stored choice.

PortalInfoDto.description: What the public needs to know about a workspace to show its help centre.

examples.subject: Cannot download my invoice
examples.description: The download button on the billing page shows an error since this morning.

examples.body: A replacement is on its way: tracking number 1Z999.

PublicAddMessageRequest.description: A reply the customer sees, or with `isInternal` a note only the team sees.

examples.subject: Order 1001 arrived damaged
examples.description: The box was crushed and the mug inside is broken.

PublicCreateTicketRequest.description: A ticket opened by an integration. The requester is matched by email or created.

PublicUpdateTicketRequest.description: Only the fields that are present are changed.

RuleAction.description:
Something a rule does. string? RuleAction.Value holds the target (a user, team, priority, status, tag or
notification audience); emails and notifications also carry text.

examples.name: Close requests that wait on the customer for two days

actions.subject: We have not heard back from you
actions.body: Hi {{customer.name}}, we marked request #{{ticket.number}} as solved. Reply to reopen it.

examples.title: How to download an invoice
examples.bodyMarkdown:
## Steps

1. Open **Billing**.
2. Choose the invoice and select *Download PDF*.

examples.reason: Card payments failed for three months.

reason.description: Why the workspace is closed, kept for the platform team. Up to 500 characters.

TicketSlaDto.description: Deadlines of a ticket. A due date is null when no policy applies or the clock is paused.

TicketViewFilter.description: The ticket list filter a saved view stores. Assignee is "me", "unassigned" or a user id.

examples.name: Acme Support
examples.portalWelcomeText: Welcome! Search our articles or send us a request.

name.description: The workspace's name, shown to the team and in the help centre.

timezone.description: An IANA time zone such as Europe/London. SLA deadlines and reports follow it.

defaultLanguage.description: en or ar: the language new customers and emails start in.

brandColor.description: The help centre's accent colour as #rrggbb. Leave empty for the default.

portalWelcomeText.description: Up to 1,000 characters greeting customers on the help centre home page.

UpdateTicketRequest.description:
Only the fields that are present are changed. Send the version you last read to be told, with a 409,
when someone else changed the ticket in the meantime.

UsageDto.description: How much of each allowance a workspace has used. A limit of null means unlimited.

WebhookSecretDto.description: An endpoint with its signing secret, returned only when the secret is created or rotated.

WorkspaceSettingsDto.description: How a workspace presents itself: its name, region, language and help centre branding.

Bearer.description: Access token returned by the login, refresh and verify-email endpoints.

ApiKey.description: A workspace API key for the public API, issued under Developers → API keys.
ApiKey.name: X-Api-Key
